tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Refined lower bound for the reduced length] ↗ lem:l-function-lower-bound ↗ claim:qk-length-bound

For $q'\in M_k$ and $0<\tau _0\leq \tau '$, \[ l_{x_k}(q',\tau ')\geq -\frac{n}{2(\tau ')^2}-\frac{n\tau '}2-1 +c_1\frac{d_{g_k(-\tau _0)}(q_k,q')^2}{\tau '}. \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ claim:qk-length-bound ↗ lem:l-function-lower-bound Apply the lemma with $q=q_k$, use Claim 3, and use monotonicity of the metric to replace $d_{g_k(-\tau ')}$ by $d_{g_k(-\tau _0)}$.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Absolute convergence of the weighted distribution]
